Metadata.title: Medilog — Smart Medical Records Platform
Metadata.description: A centralized digital platform that helps doctors organize and review their patients' medical records.

Home.title: One medical record. The complete patient history.
Home.description: Medilog is a doctor-centric digital medical platform that organizes patient data, visits, diagnoses, prescriptions, and lab results in one place, with a clear chronological medical timeline.
Home.stackDescription: The frontend is prepared with the architecture and libraries below. No business features are implemented yet.

items.next: Next.js with TypeScript, App Router, and Tailwind CSS
items.i18n: Arabic and English support with Arabic as the default locale
items.rtl: RTL direction for Arabic and LTR for English
items.font: Cairo font applied across the entire application
items.data: React Query and Zustand for data and state management
items.ui: Framer Motion, React Icons, and React Toastify

Home.note: This is a technical verification page only. Medical business modules will be built in the next phases.
